objective: Proof: under (S3) and (S4), the cheapest growth is the extended cover's cluster count on infinite pieces; a finite piece without chains follows its clusters to its top and then, if another piece holds a live knot, grows k junctions in the k-th round after its top (a relay point with two chains); if it is the only live piece it closes.
status: Proved 2026-11-19 (refereed R1, confirmed): under (S3) and (S4), a finite piece of the extended complex follows its clusters to its top and then, if another piece holds a live knot, carries a relay (one point with two endless chains: k junctions in the k-th round after the top), and otherwise closes; for knot graphs that are trees the dimension is the largest number of chains in an infinite piece, or 2 if a piece is finite; 218 of 218 small starts agree.
title: The identification with relays
